visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a black-and-white patterned cardigan and a beige scarf, drinks from a white tea cup while standing next to a large, stylized brown sloth mascot statue. (4) The camera shows an outdoor street view with a line of customers waiting on a sidewalk. A green and white public bus with the number 292 passes by on the right. (5) The focus returns to a close-up of the young child smiling and laughing enthusiastically inside the shop. The background is softly blurred, keeping the emphasis on her cheerful expression and the warm, high-key indoor lighting of the new retail environment. (6) A medium shot captures the woman and child at the store's glass entrance. The woman holds the child and makes a peace sign toward the camera. Inside the shop, several customers and staff are visible in a clean space with wooden accents and digital menus. (7) Inside the shop, the woman stands at the service counter holding the child and a beige backpack. She points at a menu on the counter while interacting with a masked staff member. Other customers are seen in the background, and a digital screen displays a video. (8) The woman and child pose next to the celebrity cardboard cutout. The woman smiles and holds a red envelope (hongbao) toward the camera, while the child looks on with curiosity. The setting is brightly lit with minimalist, modern decor and wooden furnishings. (9) The child sits on a wooden platform next to the sloth mascot statue, holding the red envelope and smiling. The composition features the mascot on the left and the child on the right, under the cartoon wall art, creating a warm, celebratory atmosphere. (10) A close-up at the counter shows a staff member's gloved hands placing several plastic-sealed tea cups with themed lids into a large, clear carrier bag. The background shows the busy and clean kitchen area where other staff members are preparing orders for the opening event.
